column1: # Two app slots for over-the-air updates: the running firmware stays in one while
# the next one is written to the other
column2: and the bootloader can go back to it.

column1: # Fits 4 MB of flash and more. Every board flashed with this table keeps these
# sizes until it is flashed over USB again
# Name
nvs
otadata
phy_init
# The last crash
column2: for `diag`: the free space before the first app slot

column1: # start on a 64 KB boundary. A board updated over the air keeps its old table and
# has no core dump until it is flashed over USB again.
coredump
# HG 本地改动：两块 app 从 1984 KB 扩到 3008 KB。16 MB 的 flash 原来只用了 4 MB，
# 而把 12x12 的 CJK 字体编进来要多吃约 158 KB，1984 KB 的槽只剩 5% 余量，低于项目
# 自己要求的 10%。扩到 3008 KB 后余量约 37%。总占用到 0x600000（6 MB）。
# nvs（0x9000，表里没列，由 IDF 按约定使用）、otadata、phy_init、coredump 全不动，
# 所以改这张表只影响 app 槽，配置和崩溃记录都保得住。改表后必须用 USB 从 0x0 全量刷。
ota_0
ota_1
